name: Ferienwohnung Kranzbichl
beschreibung:
The Ferienwohnung Kranzbichl is located in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterland. The house is in a quiet location on the edge of the village, surrounded by meadows and forests. The area is ideal for those seeking relaxation and hikers who want to enjoy the natural surroundings.

The holiday apartment offers a fully equipped apartment with a separate entrance. Guests have direct access to a balcony or a terrace.
